method: Independent re-read of the official pages with the agent's page-fetch tool, compared value-by-value against data/ea99006a/. Every read below was made in this session on 2026-11-19; nothing was copied from an earlier session's capture.
sandbox_note: The authoring sandbox cannot open a TCP connection to casino hosts (checked: HTTP 000), so reads went through the page-fetch tool. GitHub API is reachable from the sandbox.

reads.what: Venetian DeepStack Extravaganza IV schedule page, all four chunks (94 rows, 2026-11-16 .. 2026-12-23)
reads.result:
94 official rows present; the 25 rows in the planning window (2026-12-06 .. 2026-12-12) match data/ea99006a/venetian.json on date, start time, event number and structure-sheet number; 1 name-text difference (the page's '
- ...' descriptive tail is not in the site's name field for event #35). Script: scripts/recheck_2723deea.py, output data/2723deea/schedule_diff.json.

reads.what: Structure sheet 7 (events 14, 28, 63) - buy-in, house fee, prize-pool share, starting chips, level length, late registration, guarantee
reads.result: MATCH. '$90 of the $600 Buy-In is withheld for house fees', '$510 of every $600 Buy In' prize pool, 40,000 chips, 30-minute levels, 'Late Registration: 10 levels + Break (~ 4:55 PM)', 'Guarantee: $40,000 for Event #28'. Row 2026-12-06 #28 holds the same values.

MATCH on $50 house fee, $250 to the prize pool, 25,000 chips, 30-minute levels, 'Late Registration: 8 levels + Break (9:40 PM)', 'Guarantee: $15,000 (prize pool + total bounties)'. NOTE for review: this sheet's guarantees are inclusive of bounties ('A Prize Pool of $15,000 ... consists of the actual prize pool plus the total amount of $100 bounties'), and the site marks these rows 'bounty pool incl.' - consistent.
MATCH. '$90 of the $600 Buy-In ... $510 of every $600', 40,000 chips, 30 min, '10 levels + Break (4:55 PM)', 'Guarantee: $40,000 (prize pool + total bounties) Event #30'. Row 2026-12-07 #30 matches.
MATCH. '$100 of the $800 Buy-In ... $700 of every $800', 40,000 chips, 30 min, '10 levels + Break (4:55 PM)', 'Guarantee: $75,000 (prize pool + total bounties)'. Row 2026-12-09 #36 matches.

reads.what: Structure sheet 17 (events 24, 32) - $600 Seniors, and the eligibility rule printed on it
reads.result: VALUES MATCH ($90 fee, $510 pool, 40,000 chips, 30 min, '10 levels + Break (~ 3:55 PM)', 'Guarantee: $40,000'). DEFECT FOUND: the sheet face prints 'MUST BE 50+ YEARS OF AGE TO PARTICPATE' and rule 2 states a non-50+ entrant forfeits the buy-in. Rows #24 (2026-12-02) and #32 (2026-12-08) were ranked as ordinary single-entry picks and could be chosen as a day's primary event. Fixed: each row now carries the restriction label, sentence, sheet link and retrieval date; the ranking and the day plan exclude them.
MATCH. '$90 of the $600 Buy-In ... $510 of every $600', 30,000 chips, 30 min, '8 levels + break (~ 4:40 PM)', 'Guarantee: $25,000 (prize pool + total bounties)', eight-handed, pays 12.5%.

reads.what: Structure sheet 33 (event 43) - $600 LIPS Kings and Queens Bounty, 'open to all players'
reads.result: MATCH and OPEN. The sheet says 'Kings and Queens Bounty - Open to all Players' and prints the $80 house fee plus $10 LIPS fee and $510 pool exactly as the row states. This row is therefore correctly left unrestricted - the restriction test reads the sheet, not the word 'LIPS' in the name.

reads.what: Structure sheet 31 (event 35) - $600 LIPS Poker Jingle Tag Team
reads.result: VALUES MATCH ($80 + $10 LIPS, $510 pool, 40,000 chips, 30 min, '8 levels + Break (~ 2:40 PM)', $10,000). DEFECT FOUND: 'Teams: Female / Female OR Female / Male' closes the format to two-player teams. Fixed and labelled (F56).

reads.what: Structure sheet 19 (events 33, 37) - $100 LIPS Ladies milestone satellite
reads.result: VALUES MATCH ($20 fee, $80 pool, 20,000 chips, 20 min, '6 levels + Break (~6:25 PM)', 'Guarantee: 2 Seats'). DEFECT FOUND: rule 2 says 'Open to Female players'. Fixed and labelled (F56).

VALUES MATCH ($35 fee, $225 pool, 20,000 chips, 15 min, 6 levels, 'Guarantee: 2 Seats'). DEFECT FOUND (F58): the sheet prints ONE 'Late Registration: 6 levels' line for three events starting 8:10 PM, 9:10 AM and 12:10 PM with no clock time; the stored rows had copied the 8:10 PM event's derived '9:40 PM' onto the two morning rows. This matters because the overlap check uses the close time. Fixed: the builder now uses an explicit sheet clock when present and states no close time when a shared sheet gives none.
reads.diff: 2 rows no longer claim a 9:40 PM close (F60)

reads.result: MATCH. '$40 of the $260 Buy-In ... $220 of every $260', 20,000 chips, 20 min, '6 levels + Break (~6:25 PM)', 'Guarantee: 2 Seats', no eligibility restriction stated. Rows 2026-12-10 #41 and 2026-12-11 #44 match.

MATCH on '$225 of the $2,200 Buy-In ... $1,975 of every $2,200', 'Guarantee: $1,000,000', 40-minute levels, '9 levels + Break (~ 4:55 PM)', 40,000 chips. Rule 08 ('Any player who bags chips for Day 2 may not play a subsequent flight') is the reason the row is multi-entry - correctly excluded from single-entry.
MATCH. 'Rates include a daily Resort Fee of $55 plus tax per night, payable upon check-in.' The stored hotel record says '$55 plus tax per night' with this URL.

reads.what: Venetian 2026 poker suite rate (the only published numeric room rate found on any Strip property in this repo)
reads.result: MATCH. 'These rates will start as low as $119 and $209 and can be higher ... There is a $55 resort fee per night stayed ... required to play six hours of active live cash gameplay or buy in to a $300 or higher tournament for each night stayed ... prior to 2 a.m. the last night stayed.' This is a conditional floor, not a quote for 2026-12-06..13; the stored record and the site say so.

reads.what: Clark County combined transient lodging tax, resort hotel in the primary gaming corridor
reads.result: MATCH. Schedule 4.08.130: 'Resort hotel within primary gaming corridor ... 13.38%' (5% + 0.5% + 2% + 1% + 1% + 3% + 0.88%). Effective 1 March 2017. The ordinance is the published rate schedule; whether a hotel taxes the resort fee is a hotel practice question and remains flagged.

reads.what: Wynn special-offer terms behind the Wynn resort fee and cancellation figures
reads.result: MATCH. 'A daily resort fee of $55 plus tax will be added to your room account for each room night' and 'cancellations must be received at least 48 hours prior to arrival date or deposit will be forfeited'; the longer full-deposit/cancellation windows apply only to stays on 15-21 Nov 2026, 29-31 Dec 2026 and 4-6 Jan 2027, not the planning window. Consistent with stored F55/F08 text.

reads.what: WPT World Championship schedule (the other series inside the window)
reads.result: Read in full. Every event inside 2026-12-06..12 (WPT Prime Day 1B/1C/1D and Day 2, PLO Mystery Bounty, Super Gold Million flights, satellites, NLH Turbo) is a re-entry / multi-flight / satellite format; nothing there qualifies as a single-entry event, which is why the single-entry plan is Venetian-only. No value from this PDF was changed.
reads.diff: none (no single-entry WPT row exists to compare)
